This is one of the things we will never know. Brandon Sanderson has said that there were three things that Robert Jordan wanted in the last novel, but left no notes. This was one. The other two are who Nakomi was and how Rand and Moridin swapped bodies.

More (but not much) can be found [http://www.tor.com/blogs/2013/01/brandon-sandersons-wheel-of-time-answers-from-torchat here].
